coordination.dispatch_rule: Parallel independent reviews by Claude, Gemini and Codex; do not share other first-pass answers until collected. Antigravity studies consolidated version after primary reviews. Missing channel or response = record blocker, not fictional execution.
coordination.receipt_rule: Prepared is not dispatched; actual transmission/acknowledgement and returned artifact required for state transitions. No auto-dispatch by age, no new task IDs in parent clinical/implementation queue.
coordination.reconcile: One coordinator records dispositions per proposal: ADOPTAR/REFORMULAR/APLAZAR/DESCARTAR with material rationale and evidence; owner decisions only on new mature clinical questions; preserve previous approvals; if independent review unavailable, report partial, do not fabricate it.
coordination.adoption_gate: Consolidated guide v1.0 and explicit owner acceptance of scope before new UI implementation; existing authorized technical repairs remain separate.

mcp_policy.scope: All lanes and project pending tasks
mcp_policy.rule: Prefer only effectively useful authorized MCP; preserve source identity, independence and privacy. Permitted fallback when needed. Configuration is not execution.

coordination.alternate_review_disposition: Gemini remains partial and blocked. Independent Codex alternative covers only missing S04final-S10 with real attribution. Antigravity final addendum reviews exact v1 proposed guide; no complete Gemini review or owner acceptance implied.
